# Vendored C++ JSON parser

`picojson.h` is the unmodified picojson `v1.3.0` single-header parser from
https://github.com/kazuho/picojson/blob/v1.3.0/picojson.h.
Its BSD license and notices are embedded in the header. The AprilTag field
layout importer uses it to parse complete JSON without a WPILib dependency.

SHA256: `5ddf7276d04926da7be243e7af49258e78cc27278ee9097ba45b942c7a6b5f9d`.
